description: The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variant” and displays five categorical values: “Full model (MS-FSLHate)”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The y-axis is labeled with the metrics “Precision (%)”, “Recall (%)”, and “F1-score (%)”, using a linear scale ranging from 50 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are three lines plotted on the chart, each representing a different metric. The blue line represents Precision (%), starting at 65.45 for “Full model (MS-FSLHate)” and ending at 60.63 for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”; it shows a decline from approximately 65 to 61, then a slight increase to 62.22 before declining again. The green line represents Recall (%), beginning at 65.78 for “Full model (MS-FSLHate)” and concluding at 57.74 for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”; it shows a decline from 65.78 to 60.16, then a slight increase to 62.63 before declining again. The red line represents F1-score (%), starting at 65.56 for “Full model (MS-FSLHate)” and ending at 59.67 for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”; it shows a decline from 65.56 to 60.16, then a slight increase to 62.63 before declining again.
